title: OraclePhys: A Systematic Framework for LLM Fine-Tuning on Structural Mechanics
abstract: arXiv:2608.17162v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: What a language model internalizes from fine-tuning is usually diagnosed after the fact. We make it an experimental variable. OraclePhys is a systematic fine-tuning framework with three components: OraclePhys-Bench, an exactly-graded structural-mechanics benchmark whose finite-element oracle scores every answer and counterfactual edit -- no human labels, no LLM judging; OraclePhys-30K, a supervision dataset of seven answer forms over byte-identical structure descriptions; and a controlled training study across the seven forms and three verifier roles. The study yields two findings. First, the label's answer form -- not its bit count -- causally determines what fine-tuning teaches: a ranking objective installs an out-of-distribution forward model where the untrained base sits at the guessing prior, a scalar objective at best a partial one, a boolean nothing detectable; the vector-scalar gulf survives a second physics domain, a second mode

translated_title: OraclePhys：一个用于结构力学大语言模型微调的系统性框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17162v1 公告类型：新 摘要：语言模型从微调中内化的内容通常是在事后才被诊断的。我们将其变为一个实验变量。OraclePhys是一个系统性的微调框架，包含三个组件：OraclePhys-Bench，一个精确评分的结构力学基准，其有限元神谕为每个答案和反事实编辑打分——无需人工标注，无需大语言模型评判；OraclePhys-30K，一个监督数据集，包含七种答案形式，基于字节相同的结构描述；以及一项跨七种形式和三种验证器角色的受控训练研究。该研究得出两个发现。首先，标签的答案形式——而非其比特数——因果性地决定了微调所教授的内容：排名目标安装了一个分布外的前向模型，其中未训练的基座处于猜测先验，标量目标最多只能实现部分模型，布尔目标则无可检测效果；向量-标量差距在第二个物理领域和第二种模式中依然存在。
tldr: 该论文提出了OraclePhys框架，通过实验证明微调中标签的答案形式（而非数据量）因果性地决定了大语言模型学到的内容，其中排名目标能有效安装前向模型，而标量或布尔目标效果有限或无效。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces OraclePhys, a framework demonstrating that the answer form of labels, not data volume, causally determines what LLM fine-tuning teaches, with ranking objectives effectively installing forward models while scalar or boolean objectives are limited or ineffective.
